summary: Significant improvements to Firefox's compositing layer include enhanced gesture handling (disabling over-scrolling in certain scenarios and better pinch-locking for multi-touch), **hardware-decoded video HDR metadata now reaches the compositor**, ensuring accurate color rendering. The team optimized scroll update batching through IPC layers and improved autoscrolling behavior, particularly with the new Nova design. GPU fence synchronization on Metal ANGLE was strengthened, and various test cases were adapted to work with Nova's updated UI design.
